risks.risk: Brake type/condition (brakes may be weak, misaligned, or worn).
risks.proof: A short video of both brakes being pressed while the bike is held, showing immediate stopping and no rubbing/squeal; plus close-up of brake pads and cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not confirmed (assume needs service/parts).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may not work correctly (skipping gears, slipping chain, bent derailleur).
risks.proof: A video shifting through all gears while pedaling slowly, showing clean engagement on each gear; close-up of the rear derailleur and cassette/freewheel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears not confirmed (assume needs adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Tire/rim condition (punctures, dry rot, bent rim, wheel wobble).
risks.proof: Close-up of tires and sidewalls + a wheel spin video showing wobble; check for cracks and tread wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires/rims may need replacement.

risks.risk: Frame size and usability (may be kids/teen size; buyer may need adult size).
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size/seat tube measurement (or a tape measure) and a side view showing rider fit.

risks.risk: Missing parts or poor maintenance (chain rust, loose bolts, non-original components).
risks.proof: Photos of drivetrain (chain, crank, pedals), full bike straight-on, and a list of included accessories (bell, lights, reflectors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as basic used bike with unknown completeness.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of any brand/model markings on the frame (head tube) and on the crank/seat tube.
Send a short video: brakes test (front + rear) and a slow pedal test shifting through all gears.
Send close-ups of tires, chain, rear derailleur/cassette, and wheel rims (plus a wheel-spin video for wobble).
Send a side photo with a tape measure for frame/seat tube length to confirm size.
response.reason: From photo 0, the bicycle type is visible but the brand/model, brake/gear specifications, and working condition cannot be confirmed. To price safely in Oyo for a second-hand buyer, we need proof of brakes and gear shifting plus close-ups of wear-critical parts.
